observations.title: Seven notes repeat one timing verb while color and chime pitch supply the observed variation
evidence: The game defines seven ordered colors and one repeated note cycle; a successful score raises chime pitch and resets the next note's cycle (scripts/games/melody.gd:7-31,1245-1264).

The probe drives seven successful touches and a replay mixing Space, pad A and touch; its `ALL OK` establishes route assertions and state, not whether the child perceives enough variety (scripts/probe_melody.gd:2207-2264; runtime/L42/attempt_1/probe.log:240-266).

observations.proposed_repair: Do not add mechanic variation based on this hypothesis alone. Observe an uncoached child through the seven-note run and let their attention, comprehension and replay choice determine whether the current progression sustains interest.
observations.acceptance_test: During a routed child session, record whether the child independently tracks the changed note, anticipates the next pass, notices filled pips/color/chime changes, and voluntarily continues through seven notes or requests another round.

observations.title: A missed or mistimed note recovers without punishment or passive completion
evidence: The probe asserts an early tap, a wrong-location tap during green, a complete passive missed pass, and an early-held touch crossing into green all leave progress unchanged and keep Melody live (scripts/probe_melody.gd:1539-1582; runtime/L42/attempt_1/probe.log:119-124).

The code arms only when press starts in green and, for touch, in the current hit rect; scoring requires same-source release while still green and still inside the touch hit rect (scripts/games/melody.gd:1172-1225).
The note recycles on a 4.2-second loop with no countdown/fail branch; probe asserts no passive completion (scripts/games/melody.gd:7,688-713,1245-1268; runtime/L42/attempt_1/probe.log:57-59,121-123).
observations.reproduction: The focused probe waits for a non-green frame, taps early, taps outside the note during a green frame, waits through a full missed window, then holds from early into green. Each negative check confirms no award, failure or lost live state.
observations.child_impact: A missed opportunity costs time until the note cycles back but does not erase progress or end the activity. This is a forgiving recovery path in code; the child-facing emotional response and whether the wait feels too long remain unobserved.
observations.proposed_repair: Preserve this no-fail recovery. Device/child observation should check that the next moving note remains obvious after a miss and that waiting a cycle is comfortable.
observations.acceptance_test: On the actual device, deliberately let a child miss one pass without prompting; confirm they recognize another chance, recover independently, retain prior pips and do not interpret the miss as losing.

observations.title: The source-space note target is generous, but phone fit and finger drift are not verified
evidence: The visible note is 84x84 while its active rectangle is 120x120; the probe checks layout and target geometry at 1280x720 and 1280x800 (scripts/games/melody.gd:10-11,953-957,1045-1092; scripts/probe_melody.gd:628-766).

Touch drag disarms after 48 pixels or when leaving the target/window; probe injects centered synthetic press/release events and checks state (scripts/games/melody.gd:722-733; scripts/probe_melody.gd:2207-2246).
Receipt states headless=true and rendered_mobile_acceptance=false; no physical touch or Lenovo Tab M11 result is present (runtime/L42/attempt_1/receipt.json).
observations.reproduction: The probe routes synthetic presses at the moving note center; source geometry gives a 120-pixel hit box and 48-pixel drag cancellation threshold. Neither actual thumb coverage nor natural finger drift is exercised.
observations.child_impact: A child may cover the small visible note while tapping or drift more than 48 pixels during the timed press; actual success rate and comfort on the intended phone are unknown.
observations.proposed_repair: No hit-area change follows from headless geometry alone. Check projected target size, finger occlusion and natural tap drift during the device session before proposing a source adjustment.
observations.acceptance_test: On the Lenovo Tab M11 at shipping aspect, measure the projected hit region and observe uncoached one-finger taps across all note positions, including a missed pass and natural finger drift; confirm response, comfort and ownership remain clear.

observations.title: Pause, overlay and focus restoration clear held input without scoring stale releases
evidence: The probe holds touch/key/pad sources across pause, sends wrong-source releases, resumes, and verifies only the original source can clear its latch and no stale release scores (scripts/probe_melody.gd:1584-1665; runtime/L42/attempt_1/probe.log:125-170).

It also simulates standalone/nested focus/application loss, restore guards, controller disconnect and fresh-source recovery; all listed checks are `MELODY|OK` (scripts/probe_melody.gd:1892-2206; runtime/L42/attempt_1/probe.log:174-239).
The production controller tracks exact source tokens and neutralizes input on context loss/cancel (scripts/games/melody.gd:750-821; scripts/main.gd:3361-3396,3707-3733).
observations.reproduction: The single run uses synthetic touch, key and pad events with real pause/resume controls and explicit focus/application notification calls, then asserts neutral cancellation and correct-source recovery.
observations.child_impact: The tested controller path avoids accidental scoring from stale or unrelated releases and permits a fresh gesture after recovery. Real Android lifecycle delivery and physical multitouch remain unverified.
observations.proposed_repair: No defect is demonstrated in the tested controller path. Keep the device matrix independent because scripted notifications do not prove Android's actual event ordering.
observations.acceptance_test: On device, hold a note press while pausing/backgrounding, resume with a second finger or unrelated control, and release the original owner; verify zero accidental score and that a fresh deliberate tap resumes play normally.

observations.title: Snowball circle action changes the object and has a bounded assist

After 8 seconds without progress, assistance requires ongoing stick intent and adds progress; zero input is explicitly neutral (scripts/main.gd:5668-5687). The probe passed its zero-input/held-stick assist assertions (scripts/probe_mg2d.gd:77-90; runtime/L43/attempt_1/probe.log:27-28).
